rationale: The agent executed returns without authenticating the user beyond looking up by email and did not seek explicit confirmation before performing order-changing writes. It initiated returns on multiple item IDs across two orders with differing refund payment methods without confirming the items to be excluded (keyboard and mouse) or aligning clearly with the user’s stated payment preference. There’s no evidence of checking for cancellable (undelivered) items, and no final confirmation details (e.g., RMAs, labels, refund timelines) were provided. These actions violate the stated policy requirements for authentication, confirmation before writes, and providing correct final information.
